description: search-discovery preset for entity-specific image discovery (logos-in-context, product shots, screenshots) via the images SERP vertical. Serper /images provider. Query flavor ('{entity_name}' logo) is template config. verify_liveness is on because SERP image URLs rot fast; step-8 company-media should re-verify at bundle time regardless. Brand-logo LOOKUP providers (Brandfetch/Logo.dev) are NOT here — they need search-discovery code that does not exist yet (see README).
